validators.name: orbit-lint
validators.title: Orbit authority lint (ORB-1..4 + palette discipline)
validators.notes: Pack-local validator (no snapshot repo for this authority). Scans .css/.html for square-form (ORB-1), accent displacement (ORB-2), elevation (ORB-3), status-without-text (ORB-4), and raw/pastel color discipline. Report shape: findings[{rule,severity,file,line,message,excerpt,fix}], counts, by_rule, score.
